name: Potential Broken Access Control
description: Sensitive operations executed without authorization checks.
remediation_summary: Verify user authorization before sensitive actions.

name: Hardcoded Secret
description: Sensitive credentials stored directly in source code.
remediation_summary: Use environment variables or secret managers.

name: Weak Cryptography
description: Weak hashing algorithms detected.
remediation_summary: Use SHA-256, bcrypt, Argon2, or stronger algorithms.

name: Potential SQL Injection
description: User-controlled input may reach SQL queries.
remediation_summary: Use parameterized queries.

name: Potential Command Injection
description: Shell commands executed dynamically.
remediation_summary: Avoid shell execution and validate inputs.

name: Insecure Design Pattern
description: Business logic may rely on insecure defaults.
remediation_summary: Implement secure-by-default design.

name: Debug Mode Enabled
description: Debug mode may expose sensitive information.
remediation_summary: Disable debug mode in production.

name: Permissive CORS Configuration
description: CORS allows requests from all origins.
remediation_summary: Restrict allowed origins.

name: Potential Vulnerable Dependency
description: Dependency versions may require review.
remediation_summary: Review dependencies using Snyk.

name: Weak Authentication Logic
description: Authentication relies on insecure comparisons.
remediation_summary: Use secure authentication frameworks.

name: Insecure Deserialization
description: Unsafe object deserialization detected.
remediation_summary: Use safe loaders and validate input.

name: Potential Missing Security Logging
description: Exception handling without logging.
remediation_summary: Log security-relevant events.

name: Potential Server-Side Request Forgery
description: Application fetches URLs from user-controlled sources.
remediation_summary: Validate and whitelist outbound URLs.

name: Prompt Injection Risk
description: User input directly included in LLM prompt without sanitization.
remediation_summary: Sanitize user input before including in prompts. Use XML delimiters to isolate untrusted content.

name: Sensitive Information Disclosure
description: Sensitive data such as API keys or passwords may be sent to an LLM.
remediation_summary: Never include secrets, credentials, or PII in LLM prompts.

name: Supply Chain Risk
description: Unverified or unpinned LLM-related dependencies detected.
remediation_summary: Pin all LLM library versions. Audit community plugins before use.

name: Data and Model Poisoning
description: Training or fine-tuning on untrusted or unvalidated data sources detected.
remediation_summary: Validate and sanitize all training data. Use trusted data sources only.

name: Unsafe LLM Output Execution
description: LLM output executed without validation.
remediation_summary: Never execute LLM output directly. Validate and sanitize all AI responses.

name: Excessive Agent Permissions
description: LLM can trigger system actions with excessive permissions.
remediation_summary: Apply principle of least privilege. LLM should not directly trigger system calls.

name: System Prompt Leakage
description: System prompt may contain sensitive instructions or credentials.
remediation_summary: Never include secrets in system prompts. Implement prompt confidentiality measures.

name: Vector Store Data Leakage
description: Sensitive or untrusted data may be stored in vector database without sanitization.
remediation_summary: Sanitize all content before storing in vector databases. Validate retrieved content.

name: Misinformation Risk
description: LLM output used directly without validation in sensitive contexts.
remediation_summary: Validate AI outputs in sensitive contexts. Add disclaimers. Implement human review for critical decisions.

name: Unbounded Consumption
description: No rate limiting or token limits on LLM usage detected.
remediation_summary: Implement rate limiting and token limits on all LLM endpoints.
